messages:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a small change to the TTFT dashboard: we should explicitly use 'first token arrival' as the TTFT source (not start-to-end), switch the p95 panel to a 5m rolling window, and add a tokens/s distribution panel. Asking for two things: (1) perf run on canary v3 with typical chat workload, cache on/off; (2) someone to update the dashboard panels and metric names. @priya @jamie?
priya: Clarifying — how is TTFT currently instrumented? Are we using request-start -> first-token emit or model-side first-token timestamp? IIRC we have metric `ttft_ms` as a histogram bucketed at the proxy.
jamie: We have two sources: proxy-measured first_token_emit_ms and model-reported first_token_latency_ms. Proposal: canonicalize to proxy first_token_emit_ms for user-facing dashboards (captures network + queue + runtime). For p95 use a sliding 5m percentile, with a linked breakdown panel by route. For tokens/s, derive as tokens_emitted_total / request_duration_seconds, then show distribution and avg. Example Prom-ish query (approx): `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_emit_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))`
rachel: Logistics — I'll coordinate owners. @priya can you run the perf sweep? @jamie can you take the dashboard PR? I'll set a deadline EOD Thu so we can ship before next release.
priya: Will run. Need workload defs & target QPS. Also will run with cache toggled. Suggest runs: `chat_typical` (seq ~128), `chat_long` (seq ~1024), `embed_small` (tokens small). Targets: 50 qps, 200 qps, 500 qps depending on pool. Command I'll use: `./bench --workload chat_typical --qps 50 --duration 10m --canary v3 --cache on/off`
alex: Awesome — workloads: chat_typical, chat_long_seq, embed_small. Please include both cache_on and cache_off runs, and include tail latency samples. For naming, let's add metric suffix `_first_token_ms` and keep `ttft_p95_5m` panel name.
sam-infra-bot: perf run finished: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1919999999-canary-v3 — summary: chat_typical cache_on: p50=32ms p95=120ms tokens/s=180; cache_off: p50=58ms p95=260ms tokens/s=150; chat_long_seq cache_on p95=310ms tokens/s=95. Full logs: <https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/1919999999/details>
jamie: Nice. For dashboard change: panel "TTFT — first token p95 (5m)" with query pointing at `first_token_emit_ms` histogram_quantile(0.95, ...) grouped by route and model. Also add subpanel "tokens/s (avg)" using `sum(rate(tokens_emitted[1m])) by (route) / sum(rate(request_duration_seconds[1m])) by (route)` (approx). I'll draft the grafana JSON and PR.
priya: Got it — I'll attach CSV of raw samples + bench command output to the PR. Running final 10m repeats now, will upload artifacts to the perf run link.
alex: Thanks all — ping me for review on the dashboard PR, @jamie. Once PR merges we'll flip the hosted dashboard and call out the metric name change in notes. :thumbsup:
